title: Windows/Codex init (ODOC-556): bare init wizard must run on Windows, Codex skill goes where Codex reads it
description: Carrier for opum-doc ODOC-556, an operator-reported product defect (first-party, 2026-10-31). On a Windows host with Codex, the operator ran quest init selecting Codex and lore init: lore init prompted for nothing and wrote no skill and no managed block in AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md. Design decided by opum-doc: (1) on Windows a bare interactive lore init and quest init must run their wizards in PowerShell, cmd and Windows Terminal at least; where a terminal cannot be detected as interactive, init says so and names the flags rather than silently doing nothing. (2) A Codex target writes its skill where current Codex reads repository skills, verified against Codex own docs at build time, lore and quest using the same location; never .claude/ for a Codex-only target and never under .quest/. (3) Each fix gets a test that runs on a Windows CI runner. Behaviour that failed: LCLI-462 bare-init wizard TTY gate. Measured 2026-10-31 reading lore src: CODEX_SKILL_REL_PATH is .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md (src/core/codex-bridge.ts:10), while Codex docs list repo skills at .agents/skills. The release relation to the LCLI-751 hold is stated in the plan, not assumed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: On a Windows host with Codex, a bare interactive init runs its wizard and, with Codex selected, writes the skill and the managed block in AGENTS.md.
With Codex selected, init writes the skill where Codex reads repository skills (verified against Codex docs at build time), and lore and quest use the same location.
A terminal init cannot detect as interactive prints a notice naming the flags instead of silently writing no bridge.
Each fix has a test that runs on a Windows CI runner.
The fixes ship in a released version.

implementationNotes: Built on fix/LCLI-771-windows-codex-init: Codex skill path moves to .agents/skills/lore/SKILL.md; leftover .codex/skills/lore reports orphaned drift (exit 6 under --check), never deleted; pure resolveWizardGate plus stderr notice for a bare init that skips the wizard; tests incl. windows-latest tty-baseline log; mutation controls A-D red as predicted. Pre-existing on dev and unrelated: 8 failures in test/release-gate-probe.test.ts on this workstation. Manual real-terminal check on a Windows host (criterion 1) is NOT claimed from CI. Release depends on LCLI-751.

REVIEW RECORD, opum-ai/lore-cli#691. Opus review at 3b6445659fe91fcd76357fb4af08a4948ecf46ed: REQUEST CHANGES, one blocking item (the "a flagged run and a --json run stay quiet" test asserted not.toContain on text the notice does not contain, so it could never fail), made a conditional APPROVE with no re-review beyond that line. Fixed at b15c3ecd4a1ac5c48de655578ea5f176190fb096: both legs assert toBe("") and not.toContain(wizardSkippedNotice(false, false)); mutation control (notice fires on a --json run) turned red exactly the quiet-run test and the gate veto unit test. Same commit: leftover plus hand-edited skill keeps the --force remedy, an init-level both-targets test, .claude/CLAUDE.md absence asserts, detached JSDoc re-attached, .agents/ comments. Leader confirmed both legs at b15c3ec; CI 13 success and 1 skipped (promotion is manual). LIMITS NAMED IN THE PR BODY: (b) in a non-git directory a bare non-TTY run prints the notice then fails missing-git, so exit 0 holds inside a git repository only; (g) the "<= 0.14.1" and "pre-0.14.2" wording assumes the next version is 0.14.2, confirm at release. NOT DONE: criterion 1 needs the operator manual Windows check, criterion 5 needs a release, which depends on LCLI-751. Task stays In Progress.
